'''Hrym Mawarr''' was a [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Politics/Legends|politician]]. In [[43 ABY]], he was hired by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to assist [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Security|Security]] forces in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for dereliction of duty, although the Jedi was released soon after. Mawarr was later hired by Daala to capture [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] during the Knight's rampage through [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Horn, however, was apprehended by Skywalker.

==Biography==
[[File:ValinHorn-G6Sketch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Hrym Mawarr was hired by Natasi Daala to capture Valin Horn (pictured) while on Coruscant.]]
Hrym Mawarr was a [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] who made a living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] as well as a [[Politics/Legends|politician]]: he was known for returning to his home [[Star system/Legends|system]] in between stretches of [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting to spend years as an elected member of law enforcement.<ref name="outcast" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="swforums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM|quote=They way we have it right now is that Legacy of the Force ends in the middle of year 41 ABY. BLOOD OATH follows a few months later, and MILLENNIUM FALCON takes place at 43.44 ABY (these are tenths of a twelve-month year) with FotJ starting at 43.5.}}</ref> Mawarr, alongside fellow bounty hunters [[Dhidal Nyz]] and [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]], was hired by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] for her [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]] to assist [[Galactic Alliance Security]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had failed to prevent [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Under the command of Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]], Mawarr, Nyz, Kuh, and several other bounty hunters hired by Daala accompanied the Security forces during the arrest. They successfully apprehended Skywalker outside of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], although the Jedi was later released.<ref name="outcast" />

Soon after, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] suffered a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]] and went on a destructive rampage through Coruscant's [[Business district (Coruscant)|business district]]. Mawarr was among the many bounty hunters again hired by Daala for her special-missions force that attempted to capture the rogue Jedi. He was unsuccessful in this hunt, however, as Skywalker incapacitated Horn, who was then placed in the [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center]].<ref name="outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
Mawarr was well-known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for both his bounty hunting career and as a politician who had been elected to law enforcement positions in his home system multiple times.<ref name="outcast" />

==Skills and abilities==
Mawarr had [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of experience in bounty hunting.<ref name="outcast" />

==Equipment==
When traveling offworld, Mawarr wore a [[Color/Legends|bronze]] [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suit]], as Skakoans could not survive on worlds with low-pressure [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]]. During his hunt for Horn, he flew in a large green [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].<ref name="outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mawarr appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first of nine novels in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="outcast" />
